directAnswer: To reset Bluetooth transmit lossless audio, you need to clear the Bluetooth cache and re-pair your audio devices.
summary: This guide provides steps to reset Bluetooth transmit lossless audio settings on various platforms.

sections.heading: Resetting on Android
sections.body: The steps may vary slightly depending on the device manufacturer and Android version.

sections.heading: Resetting on iOS
sections.body: iOS devices have a consistent process for resetting Bluetooth settings.

sections.heading: Resetting on Windows
sections.body: Windows users can reset Bluetooth settings through the Device Manager.

steps.title: Android: Clear Bluetooth Cache
steps.detail: Go to Settings > Apps > Show system apps > Bluetooth > Storage > Clear Cache.

steps.title: Android: Re-pair Device
steps.detail: Go to Settings > Bluetooth, forget the device and then re-pair it.

steps.title: iOS: Reset Network Settings
steps.detail: Go to Settings > General > Reset > Reset Network Settings. This will reset all network settings, including Bluetooth.

steps.title: Windows: Device Manager
steps.detail: Right-click on Start > Device Manager > Bluetooth > right-click your device > Uninstall. Restart your computer and re-pair the device.

faqs.question: Will resetting Bluetooth settings delete my paired devices?
faqs.answer: Yes, resetting Bluetooth settings will remove all paired devices. You will need to re-pair them.

faqs.question: Can I reset Bluetooth settings without affecting Wi-Fi?
faqs.answer: On iOS, resetting network settings will affect both Bluetooth and Wi-Fi. On Android, clearing Bluetooth cache only affects Bluetooth.

faqs.question: What should I do if the problem persists?
faqs.answer: If issues continue, check for software updates or consult the device manufacturer's support for further troubleshooting.

caveats: The steps may vary slightly based on the specific device model and software version.
